attchmntText: Please find enclosed herewith the copy of newspaper advertisement pertaining to Extract of Un-Audited Financial Results of the Company for Quarter and Half-Year ended on September 30, 2026,
Baid Finserv Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.

With reference to our earlier intimation dated August 13, 2026, bearing Ref. No. BAIDFIN/2026-27/35, filed pursuant to Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ), regarding the completion of the second and final term of Mr. Anurag Patni (DIN: 07580695) as an Independent Director of the Company, we hereby inform you that Mr. Anurag Patni has completed his second and final term of five consecutive years and has accordingly ceased to be an Independent Director of the Company with effect from the closure of business hours on October 21, 2026.
